options.name: acl
options.description: The ACL configuration for this cluster's control plane.

options.name: apl_enabled
options.description: Whether this cluster should use APL. NOTE: This endpoint is in beta.

options.name: high_availability
options.description: Defines whether High Availability is enabled for the Control Plane Components of the cluster.

options.name: k8s_version
options.description: The desired Kubernetes version for this Kubernetes cluster in the format of <major>.<minor>, and the latest supported patch version will be deployed. A version upgrade requires that you manually recycle the nodes in your cluster.

options.name: node_pools
options.description: A list of node pools to configure the cluster with

options.name: skip_polling
options.description: If true, the module will not wait for all nodes in the cluster to be ready.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the target.

options.name: tags
options.description: An array of tags applied to the Kubernetes cluster.

options.name: tier
options.description: The desired tier of the LKE Cluster. NOTE: LKE Enterprise may not currently be available to all users  and can only be used with v4beta.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: The period to wait for the cluster to be ready in seconds.
